title: Lesson 2
paragraph: Food nouns for breakfast, lunch, and snacks.

words.meaning: a soft yellow food made from milk
dry food often eaten with milk
words.example: Cereal is easy to eat in the morning.

words.meaning: a liquid food, often made with vegetables, meat, or fish
words.example: This soup has carrots in it.

words.meaning: round bread with cheese and other food on top

sentencePractice.prompt: We baked a round base with tomato sauce and cheese on top, then cut the ____ into slices.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: A baked round base with these toppings distinguishes pizza from soup and a filled sandwich.

image.alt: チーズと丸い具がのった、丸いピザ。一切れが少し離れている。
image.creator: ProjectFluence

words.meaning: food between two pieces of bread
words.example: I made a sandwich for lunch.

sentencePractice.prompt: I put chicken between two slices of bread to make a ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Food between bread slices defines sandwich and excludes both alternatives.

image.alt: 二枚の三角形のパンの間に、葉野菜や具をはさんだサンドイッチ。
image.creator: ProjectFluence

words.example: The salad has tomato in it.

words.meaning: a small sweet baked food, usually flat and round
words.example: He ate a cookie after school.

sentencePractice.prompt: She baked small, flat, sweet treats with chocolate chips. I ate one ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Baked flat sweet treats with chocolate chips identify cookies in this choice set.

image.alt: 丸い生地に茶色いチョコチップが入ったクッキー。
image.creator: ProjectFluence

words.meaning: a sweet food made from cocoa beans

sentencePractice.prompt: This sweet brown food is made from cocoa beans. It is ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: The cocoa-bean source distinguishes chocolate from both milk products.

image.alt: 小さな四角に区切られた、茶色い板チョコレート。
image.creator: ProjectFluence

words.meaning: a small sweet cake, often shaped like a ring
words.example: I eat a donut after lunch.

sentencePractice.prompt: I chose the sweet ring-shaped cake with a hole in the middle. It was a ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: The sweet ring with a center hole distinguishes donut from both alternatives.

image.alt: 真ん中に穴がある、丸いドーナツ。
image.creator: ProjectFluence

words.usageNote: doughnut ともつづります。ここでは中央に穴のある形を画像で示しています。

words.meaning: a sweet substance added to food and drinks
words.example: She puts sugar in her coffee.
